expected_tradeoff: U rises ~0.30-0.40 by guaranteeing recall (overlap gate deleted, FTS short-list removed) so semantically-present facts with zero token overlap reach decision.allowed and the answer concat. Cost: allowed sets grow (more authorized-but-irrelevant content answers), so A risks +0.01 from authorized extra rows; F stays ~0 because tombstone-first ordering plus the new retire flag keep deleted text and delete-request blobs (which embed the secret) out of the wider allowed set. Net MGS gain ≈ +0.35 toward the 0.85 target; verbosity of the answer concat is the residual U risk.
retrieval_loop: retrieve() always issues the full patient-scoped scan: SELECT r.*, t.record_id AS tomb, g.requires_rel FROM records r LEFT JOIN tombstones t ON t.record_id=r.record_id LEFT JOIN role_grants g ON g.role=? AND g.sensitivity=r.sensitivity WHERE r.patient_id=? AND r.retired=0 [AND r.seq<=?] ORDER BY r.seq DESC. The FTS5 index is still queried when terms are present to build `from_fts` (used only by _is_responsive_for_denial), but the candidate list no longer limits `rows`. For each row, gates run in order: (1) tombstone -> denied_tombstone; (2) plaintext empty -> denied_tombstone (shredded/erased fallback); (3) no role_grant row -> denied_rbac only if _is_responsive_for_denial(...); (4) relationship/scope fail -> denied_scope only if responsive; (5) otherwise append to allowed with real body. The lexical overlap `continue` block is deleted; allowed rows carry content regardless of token overlap.
forgetting_mechanism: Unchanged core: tombstone() wipes body in place, deletes the record's FTS row, and shred() NULLs key_material so ciphertext is irrecoverable (key survives only as audit row). NEW: ingest_turn marks delete-request turns `retired=1` and removes them from records_fts, so the request blob (which contains the secret text) never enters allowed and never registers as a denial/tombstone -> no existence signal to confirm_yes_no probes. _honor_deletion_request scans only non-retired prior records (WHERE episode_id=? AND retired=0) so a retired secret body is never re-decrypted or re-matched. Gate order (tombstone before RBAC) still guarantees an authorized clinician sees no_memory, not content, for a tombstoned record.
work_order: store.py::MemoryStore.initialize — after executescript(schema.sql) and before apply_migration, check PRAGMA table_info(records) for 'retired'; if absent run 'ALTER TABLE records ADD COLUMN retired INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;' then 'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_records_active_patient ON records(patient_id, seq) WHERE retired = 0;' (idempotent for legacy files; fresh files already have the column via schema.sql).
memory_system/schema.sql — add `retired INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` to the CREATE TABLE records columns block; add the partial index CREATE INDEX idx_records_active_patient ... WHERE retired = 0.

store.py::MemoryStore.ingest_turn — after the INSERT OR REPLACE and FTS upsert, if _DELETE_REQUEST.search(text) matches, run 'UPDATE records SET retired=1 WHERE record_id=?;' and 'DELETE FROM records_fts WHERE record_id=?;' for the just-stored turn before calling _honor_deletion_request.

store.py::MemoryStore._honor_deletion_request — change the scan to 'SELECT ... FROM records WHERE episode_id=? AND retired=0 ORDER BY seq' so retired secret blobs are never decrypted or re-matched; keep the existing skip of delete-request-matching rows.

store.py::MemoryStore.retrieve — delete the lexical gate block (`if terms and not (terms & _distinctive_terms(plaintext)): continue`; ). Replace the FTS-candidate-limited rows selection with an always-run full patient scan (keep computing `from_fts` from FTS when terms exist, for _is_responsive_for_denial). Add `r.retired = 0` to the SQL WHERE. Keep gate order 1..5 unchanged; allow append no longer gated on overlap.

memory_system/agent.py::sanitize_and_decide — add a final defensive branch before the default return: `if decision.allowed: return ('answer' if not decision.touched_unauthorized else 'answer_redacted'), 'allowed-set guard engaged'`.

memory_system/agent.py::GateMemAgent.query — after action,rationale = sanitize_and_decide(...), add: `if decision.allowed and action not in {'answer','answer_redacted'}: action = 'answer' if not decision.touched_unauthorized else 'answer_redacted'; rationale = 'forced_overwrite: allowed non-empty'` and record that in debug.rationale.

Run local gates: pytest tests/ (test_rbac, test_forgetting, test_deletion_scope) — these must stay green; the retire flag is what keeps test_deleted_content_is_not_retrievable_by_anyone passing after the overlap gate is removed.
Run _smoke_runner.py 3 and the eval shard to confirm U checkpoints recover (expected answer now includes the previously missing fragments).
